profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: I look forward to solving any kind of problems that may be present in the work I do. I love to evolve and learn more every single day.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Software Engineer for the Financial Crimes Business Process Management Tool Development Project.
•	Developed backend services and REST API using Python, Flask, and MongoDB, ensuring robust and scalable server-side functionality.
•	Implemented frontend features with HTML, CSS, and jQuery and created dynamic HTML templates using Jinja, providing a responsive and user-friendly interface.
•	Enhanced application reliability by performing rigorous unit testing with pytest.
•	Created a variable configuration-driven system, enabling seamless customization for five clients.
•	Improved code maintainability by refactoring legacy systems using design patterns and best practices.
•	Partnered with DevOps and business teams to define and deliver project requirements.
•	Increased code quality and team alignment by conducting thorough code reviews and implementing best practices.
•	Mentored and supported new team members, fostering a collaborative and productive team environment.

o	Operations team for AcuraLink/HondaLink project with American Honda Motor Company, Inc.
•	Performed application monitoring and product support using Jira, DBeaver, and Postman.
•	Resolved over 1000 customer issues ranging from data inconsistency between backend services to hardware technical problems.
•	Worked closely with the application team to identify and resolve service outages.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
o	Member of the main development team in the US.
•	Developed web applications, web pages, and marketing emails with JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap.
•	Worked on the testing and quality assurance of code in the pre-deployment phase with BrowserStack and Email on Acid features.
•	Utilized Eloqua Marketing Automation system and HubSpot for deployment.
•	Monitored, updated, and improved production code for clients.
•	Collaborated with graphical designers and project managers in the web renovation of brands like IBML and HP.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
o	Broker DevOps team for Code Engine.
•	Developed a bash automation project for the insertion and correction of legal documentation required in IBM’s usage of Open-Source Software in Code Engine repositories.
•	Integrated the automation process to the team’s pipeline in Concourse CI using the GitHub CLI and Renovate.
•	Successful implementation of the project resulted in the elimination of 100% of manual work for this process on all 20 Code Engine repositories.
positions.insights: Software Development, Go (Programming Language) and +3 skills
